sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.
No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone's qualification is conditional, so it cannot receive new parts now. The only record is the 2026-10-02 minutes, so someone should confirm the status is still current.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
Meccanica Chisone told me on the phone they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The 'same alloy as BR-310' claim is a phone statement, and it names neither the alloy nor the temper.

findings.key: 8D cracking issue on SUP-C 6082 material (id not given)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone has an open cracking 8D on 6082 material, which is the alloy BR-220 uses. The documents give no issue id and no closure.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: No controlled record gives a source release for BR-220 from Chisone for any receiving plant or customer. The only statement is in meeting minutes. Absence of a release cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm the release status.

sources.quote: they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310, so it should be a formality.

findings.why: There is no 3.1 material certificate for Chisone's proposed alloy or temper. The capability claim is only verbal.
